policy: Material factual errors receive an append-only correction entry identifying the affected claim or resource, the previous statement, the corrected statement, the reason, and the correction time.

entries.prior_statement: Technocore Analytics was described as a dependency-free, read-only CLI, and the verification record said no identity or write path was found.
entries.corrected_statement: The repository now combines read-only analytics with scripts that load a local private identity and passphrase, publish signed notes and room messages, and support hourly automated publishing. The catalog entry is reclassified as unverified and warns against unattended execution.
entries.reason: Commits added after the 2026-08-26 review materially expanded the repository beyond the reviewed read-only scope, while its current README still states that the tool never posts or signs anything.
